brief: The canvas features glowing, complex geometric data visualizations composed of intersecting planes and connecting lines. Overlaying the constantly shifting background are two distinct blocks of legible text, "You're watching" and "sketchgen TV," which drift slowly across the screen. The entire composition is rendered in vibrant, glowing colors.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive, glowing geometric visualization using WebGL rendering in p5.js. The composition features multiple rotating planes that intersect in complex ways, with dynamic connection lines that pulse when planes approach each other. The entire scene slowly rotates and shifts through time, creating a sense of depth and motion without explicit movement. Two text blocks drift across the screen, maintaining legibility while adding another layer of visual interest. The glowing color palette and subtle animations create an ethereal quality that suggests both mathematical precision and organic flow. The technique relies on batched drawing operations to maintain performance while achieving a visually rich effect through layered geometric forms and dynamic lighting interactions.
